subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about completed-ride acquisition for {Brand} in South Africa. Driver supply is deep right now, with Uber running around 100,000 contractors and Bolt over 40,000 drivers, so liquidity is there to settle the demand you buy, and acquisition CPA here runs ZAR 200 to ZAR 800 per rider. That is the spread where settlement-screened events and incrementality decide your true cost per completed ride. We hold out a control group so paid first rides read as incremental to your organic riders. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: SA driver-supply liquidity (sourced) + SA CPA band ZAR 200-800
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ride_hailing SA: acknowledges follow-up and references prior outreach; fresh angle = timely market development (SA driver-supply liquidity, Uber ~100,000 contractors and Bolt 40,000+ drivers, verified via ITWeb) + real SA CPA band ZAR 200-800 per rider (verified via andpeople); cites named peers Uber and Bolt from the parent's brand set; MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference carries no figure; exactly 1 question mark; brand token kept; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y; market context sourced from verified parent URLs only.
